name: attentionless
description: A mental state where you're not focusing your mind on anything.
perceptions: I can't, or don't want to, focus my mind on anything.
results: This state may be relaxing or worrisome.
examples: An advanced meditator may be able to enter and exit this state at will.
Someone with a clinical case of 'brain fog' or depression may be trapped in this state against their will.

guidance.description: Being able to turn off anxiety-causing brain patterns is one of the goals of meditation. In this scenario, you're in control when you want to start focusing again.
There's some suggestion that minor occasional episodes of 'brain fog' may be improved with diet, exercise, and changing some habits.
If you're unable to focus on anything, you may consider seeking professional guidance.

commentaries.quote: The person who thinks all the time has nothing to think about except thoughts, and so he loses touch with reality.
Empty your mind. Be formless, shapeless like water.
The worst days are when you feel foggy in the head - chemo-brain they call it. It's awful because you feel boring. As well as bored. And stupid. And resigned.
